description: For unary \(P,Q,f\), the fresh-copy inference from \(\{P(x_0)\}\) and \(\{\neg P(f(x_0)),Q(x_0)\}\) selects their displayed opposing literals, uses exactly \([f(x_1)/x_0]\) as a most general unifier, and concludes \(\{Q(x_1)\}\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.worked_first_step.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (P Q : L.Relations 1)
  (f : L.Functions 1) :
  ∃ d,
    d.positiveFamily =
        {Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.signed true
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.unaryAtom P (FirstOrder.Language.var 0))} ∧
      d.negativeFamily =
          {Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.signed false
              (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.unaryAtom P
                (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.unary f (FirstOrder.Language.var 1)))} ∧
        d.unifier = Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.workedMu f ∧
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.resolvent d =
            Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.workedMiddle Q
